user.title: Add a vehicle
user.description: Track South Australian vehicle registration expiry, CTP insurer, inspection status and more from South Australia's public registration check.

data_description.plate: The vehicle's South Australian number plate, letters and numbers only (for example S123ABC). Spaces and case are ignored.

reconfigure.title: Change the plate number
reconfigure.description: Correct the plate number for this vehicle.

data_description.plate: The vehicle's South Australian number plate, letters and numbers only. Spaces and case are ignored.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the registration check service. Check your network connection and try again.
error.invalid_plate: The registration check did not accept this plate number. Check it and try again.
error.unexpected_response: The registration check replied, but this integration could not read the reply. Try again later. If it keeps happening, the service may have changed; the Home Assistant log has details.

init.title: SA EzyCheck options
init.description: Change how SA EzyCheck polls for data.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to check for new data, in minutes. Registration details rarely change, so the default is twelve hours.

cannot_connect.message: Could not fetch data from the registration check service: {error}

invalid_plate.message: The registration check no longer accepts the plate {plate}. Use Reconfigure to correct the plate, or reload the entry to try again.

persistent_fetch_failure.title: SA EzyCheck is not updating
persistent_fetch_failure.description: SA EzyCheck has failed to update "{entry_title}" {threshold} times in a row. The registration check may be down, may no longer accept the plate, or may have changed how it answers; the Home Assistant log says which. No action is needed if it clears on its own. If it keeps failing and the log says the answer could not be read, please open an issue on GitHub.
